title: S3 bucket security detail
description: Full security attributes for one bucket: public access block, encryption, versioning, ownership.

cost.notes: One request per bucket when iterated over an inventory

template: SELECT bucket_name, region, public_access_block_configuration, bucket_encryption, versioning_configuration, ownership_controls FROM aws.s3.buckets WHERE region = '{{region}}' AND Identifier = '{{bucket_name}}';
notes: Keyed read: one request per bucket. A 404 with an empty result means the bucket does not exist - a valid answer, not a failure.
